Lena (product): Heads-up: rolling out v3.9.0 onprem feature today - Local Entitlement Export + Self-Service Key Rotation for Private/VPC customers. Aim: let customers generate verifiable entitlement artifacts and rotate signing keys without contacting support. Opt-in.

Lena (product): Why: customers asked for a way to hand auditors a compact entitlement snapshot and to self-rotate signing keys on their timeline. This avoids forced rotations and keeps telemetry in-customer.

OpsBot: Deploy started: v3.9.0-local-entitlement -> canary eu-west-2 at 3887654400 :rocket:

Ibrahim (eng): Implementation notes: entitlement export bundles contain role mappings, operator session indices, and integrity hashes. Bundles are signed by the local signing key (KMS-backed if configured). Rotation is short-lived cert + key roll; we emit metrics for rotation.latency and rotation.failure.

Pri (security): Compliance note: recommend customers configure HSM/KMS for the signing key and set policy for rotation cadence. For SOC2 customers we suggest evidence retention >= 180 days and to enable attestations. We'll add a sample auditor checklist.

Maddie (docs): I'll draft the KB and include CLI examples + a step-by-step for key rotation and bundle verification. Any preferred snippets?

Lena (product): Use these CLI examples in KB:
```
# create an entitlement export for auditors (dry-run shows contents)
redwoodctl entitlement export --scope all --dry-run

# perform export and sign with local key
redwoodctl entitlement export --scope operators,roles --out ent-2026-06-01.tar.gz

# rotate local signing key and show generated certs
redwoodctl keys rotate --target signing --confirm
redwoodctl keys list --filter signing
```

Rory (sales): Sales ask: short customer blurb I can include in outreach?

Lena (product): One-liner: "Self-Service Key Rotation + Entitlement Export lets you produce verifiable, on-prem audit artifacts and rotate signing keys on your schedule without sending telemetry off-site."

Ibrahim (eng): Fallback behavior: if a rotation fails mid-flow we automatically roll back to the previous key and log the event in the export bundle; failures trigger a high-priority Console alert and a rollback audit entry.

Pri (security): Add a KB section showing how to verify the export signature locally and sample queries an auditor might run against the bundle. Also include HSM/KMS config examples.

Maddie (docs): Will add a verification section and the rotation runbook. I'll link to the sample auditor checklist.

OpsBot: Canary complete at 3887654700, monitoring window 2h.

Ibrahim (eng): I'll run a staged rotation and export against the compliance tenant tonight and post results. Tagging @Pri for verification.

Rory (sales): I'll email pilot accounts this afternoon with the blurb + link to KB when live.

Lena (product): Action items: Maddie -> KB + verifier steps; Ibrahim -> staged rotation + export; Pri -> auditor checklist + HSM guidance; Rory -> pilot outreach. Please react with :thumbsup: when your item is done so we can graduate this out of canary.
